1 (Currently amended): A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material using a non-destructive medium; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

2 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of __water__.

7 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with __a cell wall degrading enzyme__.

11 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more __immature plant embryos__.

13 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is __selected from the group consisting of genotyping, DNA sequencing, and PCR-based analysis__.

17 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on __the results of the molecular analysis__. 

18 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos.
